newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tysan buys Shanghai prop'ty firm for shrs.
newsitem.headline: Tysan buys Shanghai prop'ty firm for shrs.

text.p: Tysan Holdings Ltd said on Monday it bought a 60 percent stake in a Shanghai property firm, China Garden International Ltd, for HK$64.9 million from independent third parties.

The consideration would be satisfied by the issue of 37.3 million new shares, accounting for about 6.23 percent of Tysan's enlarged issued share capital, at HK$1.74 each, the company said in a statement.
The share price represented a 2.4 percent premium to the shares' Friday close of HK$1.70, it said.
China Garden owns the China Garden Apartments, which has a total of 82 service residential units leased to expatriate staff and their families, it said.
The gross annual income and gross yield of the property was about HK$23.6 million and 22 percent respectively, Tysan said.
The sellers said they would hold the consideration shares for a minimum period of six months, it added.
